title: Step a traffic light
prompt: Write `nextLight(light: "red" | "green" | "yellow"): "red" | "green" | "yellow"`. Red goes to green, green goes to yellow, and yellow goes to red.
hints: Write the three moves as a list before you write code.
Each input has exactly one next color.
The return type is the same union, so a typo such as `"gren"` is a type error.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Sends green back to red, skipping yellow.

feedback: Write the three moves as a list before you write code.
